contribution: Combines parametric generation with a dense non-parametric index and shows gains on knowledge-intensive tasks.
evidence_relevant_to_pilot: Provenance and updatable knowledge motivate retrieval, but the paper does not solve bad-retrieval detection or citation calibration.
limitation: Retrieved context quality remains an upstream dependency.
title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks

contribution: Learns adaptive retrieval and reflection tokens for retrieval need, relevance, support, and generation quality.
evidence_relevant_to_pilot: Supports adaptive retrieval and critique, but requires training and does not isolate the support calibration of the current pipeline.
limitation: The intervention is not a drop-in test for a frozen model.
title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection

contribution: Uses a retrieval evaluator to trigger corrective retrieval actions and decompose then recompose noisy evidence.
evidence_relevant_to_pilot: Direct prior art for retriever robustness when retrieved documents are irrelevant or incomplete.
limitation: Its web-search extension is outside the frozen support corpus.
title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation

contribution: Separates retrieval and generation quality with reference-free metrics for context relevance, answer relevance, and faithfulness.
evidence_relevant_to_pilot: Provides a practical evaluation scaffold for the pilot's unsupported citation and irrelevant-context failures.
limitation: Automatic metric calibration still needs human validation.
title: RAGAS: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation

contribution: Shows that relevant information position materially affects long-context performance, with middle positions often used less effectively.
evidence_relevant_to_pilot: Motivates position-controlled stress tests before attributing failures only to retrieval relevance.
limitation: It studies context use, not a complete support-domain RAG stack.
title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
